title: Antisemitic Messages? A Guide to High-Quality Annotation and a Labeled Dataset of Tweets
reasoning: The paper's central topic is the detection and annotation of antisemitic messages, which represent hate speech and discrimination against a religious/ethnic group. It explicitly employs the International Holocaust Remembrance Alliance (IHRA) definition of antisemitism, a recognized standard for identifying ethically problematic speech. This directly engages with ethical considerations concerning discrimination and hate speech against a specific faith-identified community.
